maya: Heads-up — we're starting the all-hands at 11:05 (running a bit late). There's a persistent low-frequency hum on the live feed. If you hear it on your end, confirm.
ops-bot: Deploy queued: allhands-stream-v2 (auto-failover enabled) 
media_tom: I can mute the room mic and switch to backup ISO cam. Will take ~30s, starting now.
devon: If we lose captions on ISO, @prod_anna can paste the live notes. Also tagging @sam (eng) for obs switch.
sam (eng): On it — doing an OBS scene swap and muting the main audio input. Command I'm running: `obs-cli scene switch "ISO-CAM" && obs-cli audio mute "Room Mic"`
maya: @ceo_julia are you ok to hold on slides until we confirm audio? We'll keep Q&A open here and do a live handoff to @prod_anna.
ceo_julia: Good call. Hold on slides until we confirm audio is clear. I'll wait to start my deck.
media_tom: Switched to ISO cam and muted stage mic. Doing a quick loopback check — hum reduced but still a faint tone.
maya: Can someone confirm local recorder is still capturing? I don't want to lose the first 2 mins.
devon: Recorder status: `REC: idle -> starting` trying to start now, disk checks OK.
sam (eng): Confirmed local recorder rolling: `recording: true`, file: `/mnt/rec/allhands_3165432101.mp4`
prod_anna: I'll shepherd the Q&A queue. Please drop questions here with :hand: or post in Zoom reactions. I'll route priority ones to Julia.
random_user: audio is clearer for me now :+1:
media_tom: Captions service reattached, live caption latency ~2s. Will keep ISO feed as fallback for 5 mins.
maya: OK starting slides in 30s. @media_tom keep ISO up and don't kill main until we confirm stable.
ceo_julia: Quick live question for roadmap — will Dedicated autoscaling beta be available in Q2?
prod_anna: Short answer live: yes, limited beta in Q2, broader rollout Q3. I'll drop the follow-up doc here: https://go.redwood/roadmap-dedicated-beta
maya: Action items captured: 1) post follow-up doc to #docs, 2) clip first 5 mins for KB, 3) ops to post incident INC-4632 for audio hum root cause.
devon: Root cause looks like a ground loop from the stage mixer — filing INC-4632 with immediate mitigation steps.
maya: Thanks everyone — stream stable, starting main agenda now. If anything pops after, ping me directly or reopen this thread.
